runtimeBoundary.originalWebApp: Existing app.js initially implements Services loop only; Projects, Level Up and Start were direct public links, Studio disabled, Memento overview.
runtimeBoundary.v008Routes: data/paths_world_v008.json has 171 public routes plus 30 internal definitions, Web Y-up, piecewise cubic position curves with arc-length tables, quintic easing, yaw/pitch look directions and separate target distance, six icon yaw channels, entry and exit masks.
runtimeBoundary.recommendation: Use a compact runtime derivation of the exact route definitions and verify sampler parity before claiming v008 path invariants. Do not ship the full offline path audit/timeline JSON as a startup request. Existing Services interpolation is not evidence that v008 validated paths execute in web.
runtimeBoundary.fullContentLoops: Only local Services loop is in this export scope. Four external standalone destinations preserve the landing tab and are not certified embedded TIDE content loops.
